Overview

Kano is a city in Kano with a population of 4,103,000. The largest city in northern Nigeria and a historic center of trade, Islamic scholarship, and textile manufacturing. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
